advisories.claim: Line 422 comment says 'exactly 30 s after the first probe', but the test advances the clock to 31 s; the exact 30 s boundary (now - probed_at == 30) is never asserted.

_REFRESH_JS treats every input with a non-empty value as 'holding'; a checkbox, radio or input type=submit always has a value (default 'on' or the label), so if the home page ever renders one, the countdown would hold forever. Restricting the check to text-like input types would close this; the diff does not show whether such inputs exist on home().

The countdown hold, the focus check and the reload behaviour live only in client-side JS and are not exercised by any test; the tests only check that the markup and the server-side behaviour are present.
The lint section of the lead's results is empty, so lint was not shown to run on this change.
The ResourceWarning in the test output comes from the pre-existing summary read (open(path) without close, around line 439), not from this diff; it is noise here but unrelated to the change.

tests: Covers the Refresh-now and interval control markup, route registration, cookie set and round-trip for every offered value, server-side rejection of 1, 0, bogus, 15x and padded values, invalid cookies ignored on home, the badge using the cached probe while routing uses the live probe, the 30 s badge cache for online and offline nodes, and summary and search pages staying still; misses the exact 30 s boundary, the browser-side hold and reload behaviour, and a real HTTP cookie round-trip.
